Once that's fixed, I can set up the digest: 09:00 America/Chicago starting tomorrow, Wednesday 2026-10-15, as a DM to you of new #coastal-team messages. You're a member of that channel, so I can read it for you.

Until then, if you want a digest on demand, I can post one here whenever you ask.
